sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: A session is a collection of related traces, such as a conversation or thread. To begin, add a sessionId to the trace.
sessions.addToQueueDescription: Add selected sessions to an annotation queue.
sessions.sessionAddedToQueueDescription: Selected sessions will be added to queue "{queueName}". This may take a minute.

users.title: Users
users.description: Attribute data in Langfuse to a user by adding a userId to your traces.
users.userIdTooltip: The unique identifier for the user that was logged in Langfuse. See docs for more details on how to set this up.
users.firstEventTooltip: The earliest trace recorded for this user.
users.lastEventTooltip: The latest trace recorded for this user.
users.totalEventsTooltip: Total number of events for the user, includes traces and observations. See data model for more details.
users.totalTokensTooltip: Total number of tokens used for the user across all generations.
users.totalCostTooltip: Total cost for the user across all generations.

detail.title: Session Detail
detail.notFoundMessage: The session is either still being processed or has been deleted.
detail.unauthorized: You do not have access to this session.
detail.noInputOutput: This trace has no input or output.
